Definition: from G1722 and G473; in front (i.e. figuratively, presence) of:--before.
BiblicalUsage: Enanti means 'before' — in front of, in the sight of. Peter tells Simon his heart is not right in the sight of God in Acts 8:21, and Zacharias executes the priest's office before God in Luke 1:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every heart stands before God exactly as it is, and no religious office can cover a heart that is not right.
